items.source:
This package contains configuration related support classes that
can be used for application specific, annotated configuration classes.
items.translation: 该包包含与配置相关的支持类，可用于针对特定应用程序的注解式配置类。

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Provides a set of simples types that SDN supports.
items.translation: 提供了一组 SDN 支持的简单类型。

items.source: This package contains the callback API.

This package contains the schema that is defined by a set of classes, representing
nodes and relationships and their properties.
items.translation: 该包包含由一组类定义的架构，这些类表示节点、关系及其属性。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of support classes that might be
helpful in your domain, for example a predicate indicating that some transaction may be
retried and additional converters and id generators.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些可能对您领域有帮助的支持类，例如指示某些事务可重试的谓词，以及额外的转换器和 ID 生成器。

items.source:
Contains the core infrastructure for translating unmanaged Neo4j
transaction into Spring managed transactions.
items.translation: 包含将未管理的 Neo4j 事务转换为 Spring 管理事务的核心基础设施。

items.source:
This package provides the Neo4j imperative and reactive
repository API.
items.translation: 该包提供了 Neo4j 命令式和响应式仓库 API。

items.source:
Configuration infrastructure for Neo4j specific repositories,
especially dedicated annotations to enable imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j
repositories.
items.translation: 为 Neo4j 专用仓库配置基础设施，特别是通过专用注解来启用命令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库基类。
